purpose: Reviewer-facing workflow for completing one canonical Shine Defence review checklist without manually editing JSON.

modes.meaning: Read-only progress view showing candidate identity, evidence, completed counts, gaps and the next unreviewed requirement.
Update exactly one checklist requirement to unreviewed, satisfied or not_satisfied with bounded evidence references and reviewer notes.
Record an explicit human approved or rejected attestation after checklist state permits that outcome.

rules: Workspace status is read-only and never changes certification state.
Record mode changes exactly one existing checklist item and is allowed only while humanAuthorization is pending.
Evidence references must name evidence ids already copied into the canonical checklist.
A satisfied requirement must retain at least one evidence reference or a non-empty reviewer note.
Authorization is never inferred from requirement states; it requires a separate explicit authorize action.
Approved authorization requires every checklist item to be satisfied and requires literal confirmation APPROVE.
Rejected authorization requires at least one not_satisfied item and requires literal confirmation REJECT.
Authorization requires a bounded reviewer id, explicit ISO reviewedAt timestamp and bounded human summary.
Once approved or rejected, workspace v1 treats the checklist as finalized and refuses further edits.
Every proposed mutation is validated against the exact candidate and current canonical registry before it can be written.
Apply mode writes only the canonical checklist file and runs the checklist repository verifier; verification failure restores the previous file.
nonClaims: The workspace does not verify the real-world identity of the reviewer.
The workspace does not decide whether evidence is true or sufficient.
Completing requirements does not itself certify a release.
Only the separate first-certification or re-certification helper may consume an approved checklist to create certification state.
